mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
